title: Grok Plugin Marketplace Index
description: Repo-level marketplace index. Config files: `.grok-plugin/marketplace.json` (preferred), `.grok-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (checked in that order; first existing file wins) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-plugin-marketplace/src/index.rs:211-246]. Deserialized into `MarketplaceIndex` [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-plugin-marketplace/src/index.rs:18]. Forward-compatible: unknown top-level keys (e.g. `$schema`, `metadata`) are ignored by serde [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-plugin-marketplace/src/index.rs:239 test parse_full_superpowers_marketplace].
